pages.text: Bog Toad Skin is tough, but smelting turns it into $(item)Boghide$(), supple and water-shedding. Sewn into a full set it lets a swamp walker move through the mire the way a toad does.

pages.title: Boghide
pages.text: Smelt Bog Toad Skin in a furnace.

pages.title: Leggings & Boots
pages.text: Lighter than iron, but the boots are as protective as iron ones, and sturdier.

pages.title: Toad's Gait
pages.text: In water the boots grant $(thing)Bogstride$(): you swim 35% faster and your air lasts twice as long, though they will not let you breathe underwater.$(br2)On land, jump while sprinting to leap forward like a toad. The leap has a 10 second cooldown and costs the boots a little durability. Land within ten seconds of leaping and the impact damages hostile creatures close by.

pages.title: Toadskin
pages.text: Wear all four pieces and the hide turns the rot aside: you are $(thing)immune to Bogrot$(), and the boots' leap recovers in 8 seconds instead of 10. A leap landing also slows nearby hostiles and leaves them taking a quarter more damage from you for four seconds, while you move faster for three, and the hide takes a tenth less damage in water, mud or swamps.
